_meta.description: Master list of candidate instruments for The Leap. Every row is either sourced to a registered source_id or carries an explicit null. No field is inferred from an unregistered source.

field_policy.contract_multiplier: Captured verbatim from the CME Group contract-spec page of each product (batch closed 2026-09-16). See research/evidence/CME-CONTRACT-SPECS-BATCH2.md.
field_policy.verified_historical_return_multiple: always null in this batch. Populated only with an explicit start price, end price, window and source.
field_policy.max_underlying_exposure: computed = max_open_position_contracts * contract_multiplier. Computed, not sourced.
field_policy.underlying_price_move_needed_for_current: computed = current rank-1 realized P/L / max_underlying_exposure. Computed, not sourced. Requires no price input.
